The 'transfer' function allows the user to transfer tokens to an address, without ensuring the recipient's balance is not set to a value greater than 2^256-1, leading to an integer overflow in the recipient's balance.

The 'transferFrom' function allows the user to transfer tokens from one address to another, without ensuring the recipient's balance is not set to a value greater than 2^256-1, leading to an integer overflow in the recipient's balance.
The 'approve' function allows the user to set allowance for a spender, without ensuring the allowance is not set to a value greater than 2^256-1, leading to an integer overflow in the allowance.
The 'setOwner' function allows the owner to set a new owner, without ensuring the new owner is not the zero address, leading to a loss of funds.
